business_problem: MediaRadar | Vivvix provides comprehensive advertising intelligence that empowers brands to understand and optimize their ad spending across all media channels. Initially, MediaRadar | Vivvix faced challenges with manual data processing and fragmented workflows that made it harder to support a rapid growth in ad volumes.

Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets. Databricks Model Serving hosts production model endpoints or LLM interfaces used by applications and business users.
